comments: Comprehensive review establishing topological photonics as transitioning from static demonstration to active reconfigurable platform; integration challenges and scalability pathways are key open questions.

title: Stochastic switching time constant and instability in nanomagnets
task: Measurement and modeling of stochastic switching time constant in nanomagnets
key_results: Attempt time τ₀ = 3.7–12 ns (not 1 ns) determined via hard-axis random telegraph noise; Suhl instability increases τ₀ via spin-wave emission by 2–3× factor
comments: Resolves a long-standing ambiguity in nanomagnet physics critical for stochastic computing applications; spin-wave contribution to switching dynamics is non-trivial.
